display_information.name: Kaffi
display_information.description: Office coffee leaderboards from the kaffi knob
display_information.long_description:
*Kaffi* posts the office coffee leaderboard to Slack.

Each office has a kaffi knob by the coffee machine. Turn it to pick your name, tap to log that you brewed a pot or took a cup. Every tap is an event in Sanity, and the scoreboard falls out of the event log: brewing earns credit, taking cups spends it. Positive balance makes you a hero, negative makes you a freeloader. Streaks reward the people who brew on consecutive weekdays.

This app posts that scoreboard on a schedule, once per office to the office's own channel, in the office's local time. It only posts. It reads no messages, has no commands, and runs no server: a scheduled Sanity Function calls chat.postMessage with a Block Kit summary and nothing else.

*Permissions:* chat:write, and only in channels where @Kaffi has been invited.

*Source and setup:* github.com/RostiMelk/knob, under apps/kaffi. Maintained by Knut Melvær and Rosti.
